scope: Pilot-2026 CO2 observation layer conditional on fixed Pilot-2026 upstream kinetics

co2_preprocessing.sensor_normalization: fixed prior background and reactor gains from baseline calibration
co2_preprocessing.sensor_normalization_caveat: same-campaign prior; no pre-inoculation zero available
co2_preprocessing.sampling_artifact_filter: local MAD plus sample-window excursion; first 4 h after nutrient pulse protected
co2_preprocessing.hourly_smoother: 3-point median followed by 5-point quadratic Savitzky-Golay within pulse segments

time_alignment.end: active_end from first cooling event or last primary sample

nutrient_pulse.lot3_events: owner-confirmed reconstruction from matching Lot-1 schedule

identifiability_limitations: pH and dissolved O2 only in Lot 3 at sparse times starting at 16 h
one invalid pH=30.3 row excluded visually
only two calibration fermentations per lot after the holdout

cross_scale_interpretation.laboratory_synthetic_to_pilot: matrix and scale change together; effects are confounded
cross_scale_interpretation.pilot_to_laboratory_synthetic: matrix and scale change together; effects are confounded
